title: Iraq plans to raise oil output to 8mln to 10mln bpd within six years, PM says
summary: A ministerial committee had been sent to Saudi Arabia to discuss expanding Iraq’s OPEC production quota: PM

FILE PHOTO: Iraqi Prime Minister-designate Ali al-Zaidi speaks during a parliamentary session to vote in a new government headed by Ali al-Zaidi as prime minister, at the parliament headquarters in Baghdad, Iraq, May 14, 2026. REUTERS/Ahmed Saad.

A ministerial committee had been sent to Saudi Arabia to discuss expanding Iraq’s OPEC production quota: PM

Muayad Hameed | Reuters News

Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi said on Friday that the country plans to raise oil production to between 8 million and 10 million barrels per day within six years.

He said a ministerial committee had been sent to Saudi Arabia to discuss expanding Iraq’s OPEC production quota. 

Iraq was also working to export oil through Syria’s Baniyas port and Jordan’s Aqaba port, he added.

(Reporting by Muayad Hameed Writing by Eman Abouhassira Editing by David Goodman )
